name: active_goal_
initialization: empty; set after validated goal ingress; cleared on epoch reset/fail-closed paths
meaning: runtime desired request identity and route payload
writers: onGoal/applyValidatedGoalLocked; foreign-mission transition; localization epoch reset; failClosedLocked/goal clear
readers: currentPlanningKey; runCycle request snapshot; candidate admission/activation guard; publishCommand identity checks
reset: clear on localization reset/fail closed; replaced only after goal validation
clock_unit: ROS header stamp in goal; no timer stored in field
identity: mission_id, waypoint_index, request_id, route_revision, active_goal_epoch
protection: input_mutex_ under canonical localization->input->command transition order

name: executing_goal_
initialization: empty; may remain old while desired PASS_THROUGH successor is pending
meaning: goal identity corresponding to physical command timeline; changes on immediate commit or pending activation
writers: admitImmediateCandidate; apply queued timeline activation; epoch/fail-closed invalidation
readers: command timeline/current planning key checks; publishCommand final exposure; recovery attribution
reset: cleared/reinitialized at reset/revocation; swapped on timeline cutover
identity: goal tuple + command_goal_epoch + bundle generation
protection: input_mutex_ and command transition mutex; timeline finalization is separate store boundary

name: PendingGoalHandoffOwner::pending_goal_
initialization: empty
meaning: single latest admissible same-mission goal deferred while moving safety suffix owns execution
writers: enqueue after goal admission under suffix guard
readers: measured-stop handoff and pending goal consumption; timeline activation guard
reset: consume exact pointer after successor cutover or clear on invalidation/foreign mission
identity: mission/waypoint/request and localization/goal epoch recheck
protection: owner mutex plus runtime transition locks

name: active_goal_epoch_
meaning: monotonic runtime goal/request invalidation token; distinct from request id
writers: validated goal transition; foreign goal transition; epoch/fail-closed paths
readers: PlanningKey/request validation; candidate admission/commit/activation/publication
reset: incremented/bumped by goal and lifecycle changes; zero is invalid in candidate identity
identity: not interchangeable with localization_epoch or request_id
protection: atomic plus transition locks for compound state

name: active_localization_epoch_ / localization_epoch_ready_
initialization: epoch 1 / ready true
meaning: state/map coordinate lifetime and readiness latch; reset blocks command exposure until new world/state is established
writers: onPropagatedOdometry/onEstimatorHealth epoch transitions; localization reset handler
readers: state input, PlanningKey, candidate validate/commit and final command exposure
reset: higher epoch drains/cancels and invalidates; readiness restored only after reset requirements
identity: PropagatedOdometry.localization_epoch, health epoch, world identity
protection: atomics and localization_transition_mutex_

name: ExecutionEpisode::Snapshot::recovery_state
initialization: InitialHold; state resides in mutex-protected Episode snapshot
meaning: runtime's physical execution recovery authority; pure transition helper alone does not commit state
scope: one execution episode and active candidate identity
writers: ExecutionEpisode beginGoal/commandCommitted/observeSampledSafetyRole/stoppedHold/failClosed; runtime applyExecutionRecoveryEventLocked
readers: planning admission/key, candidate commit, sample handling, command role policy
reset: beginGoal or failClosed changes episode; exact generation checks reject stale mutators
identity: goal epoch, localization epoch, request id, active bundle generation
protection: ExecutionEpisode mutex plus runtime compound transition locks

name: Snapshot::failure_latched / command_execution_lease_failure_latch_
initialization: false / allows initial exposure
meaning: fail-closed command stop; latch serializes one-time lease failure while episode denies command
writers: execution freshness failure in publishCommand; failClosedLocked/ExecutionEpisode; epoch reset
readers: commit/activation/sample/publication guards
reset: explicit fresh lifecycle/reset only; no automatic expiry
identity: current command goal and execution epoch
protection: episode mutex and latch transitionMutex_

name: active_ / pending_ / version_
initialization: empty; updates through guarded store methods
meaning: sole runtime committed/executing command bundle authority; pending does not execute before due activation
writers: tryCommitIfCurrent; stagePending; activatePendingIfDueAndFinalize; invalidate/recertify
readers: CommandSampler, candidate prep/admission, publishIfCurrent, diagnostics
reset: revoke/invalidate on identity/world/state/lifecycle failure
identity: world snapshot identity, goal/localization epoch, request id, bundle generation, txn/version
protection: store mutex and compare-token rechecks

name: active_ / pending_
type: active job + optional latest pending job
initialization: none; started with worker
meaning: one serial planner and one replaceable pending request; queue state is scheduling, not execution authority
writers: submit/cancel/cancelIdentity/shutdown; worker run loop
readers: worker loop, status snapshots, runtime scheduling
reset: pending replacement/drop and shutdown/join
clock_unit: steady clock for runtime watchdog; job keys include stamps
identity: PlanningKey incl localization/goal/request/world/dynamics identity
protection: worker mutex; planner backend recursive mutex for run/cancel path
roles: authoritative control state for queue only; identity/version

name: navigation_command_
initialization: empty; invalidated at activate/deactivate
meaning: last locally admitted ROS command snapshot; not evidence of PX4 application
writers: onNavigationCommand commit transition; transitionCertifiedCommand retain/invalidate; mode activation/deactivation/failure
readers: updateMission continuation/terminal witness; updateSetpoint PVA and lease gates
reset: invalidate on activation/deactivation, terminal fail/handover and selected command changes
clock_unit: ROS source/valid_until plus steady receive stamp
identity: mission/waypoint/request/epochs/world/generation/sample id
protection: trajectory_mutex_ serializes with mission timer and cache mutations

name: active_waypoint_index_ / request_id_ / route_progress_
initialization: mission start/checkpoint on activate; request advances monotonically
meaning: PX4-side mission progression identity based on accepted measured evidence
writers: activate/deactivate checkpoint; update accepted waypoint; retry failed goal
readers: update guard, goal publisher, command identity admission
reset: reactivation resumes checkpoint and increments request; mission replacement constructs controller
clock_unit: seconds for internal retry/progress sample timing
identity: mission id + waypoint index + request id + route revision
protection: MissionController mutex; called under NavigationMode trajectory_mutex for cross-object linearization

name: trajectory_ready_
initialization: false/reset on activation; on accepted trajectory set true
meaning: mode-side readiness latch gates mission progression and initial planner acquisition; does not prove command currently leased
writers: onTrajectory/onNativeTrajectoryReady and failure/reset paths
readers: MissionController::update and state transitions
reset: false on goal replacement, deactivation, error; set by admissible command trajectory
identity: current MissionController request, but NavigationCommand admission has separate correlation checks
protection: MissionController mutex

name: terminal_hold_pending_ / pending_position_control_
initialization: false; activated on STOP or safety fallback paths
meaning: separate mission-level terminal settling and requested mode handover flags; neither equals measured stop, waypoint accepted, or mission complete
writers: onTrajectory role/kind transitions; update STOP/safety timeout; deactivate/reset
readers: MissionController::update branch order; NavigationMode event handling
reset: cleared only after measured confirmation or explicit lifecycle transition
identity: current mission waypoint/request
protection: MissionController mutex under trajectory lock at mode boundary

name: safety_suffix_handoff_pending_ + waypoint/request tuple
initialization: false/zero; set when retaining a matching BACKUP command across waypoint handoff
meaning: PX4-side permission to admit exact old safety suffix while new goal is being planned; not the runtime pending-goal owner
writers: handleMissionEvent PublishGoal; onNavigationCommand accepted current command/reset/deactivate
readers: onNavigationCommand identity admission, updateMission suffix-stop decision
reset: first accepted new-goal command, lifecycle reset, or safety handover
identity: old backup waypoint/request plus new current request
protection: trajectory_mutex_

name: planner_recovery_pending_ + deadline + identity
initialization: false; timer starts on specific terminal/completed command recovery path
meaning: adapter-side bounded window waiting for fresh planner command after endpoint; separate from runtime ExecutionEpisode::StoppedRecovery
writers: updateSetpoint completed command branch and clear/reset helper
readers: updateSetpoint fresh/stale command handling, updateMission timeout
reset: fresh admissible command, lifecycle/handover, or timeout/failure
identity: mode-side mission/wp/request/bundle generation
protection: trajectory_mutex_

name: px4_local_frame_aligned_ / PX4 reset counters
initialization: false; align from stationary paired LIO/PX4 observations
meaning: frame witness gates ENU-to-PX4 setpoint conversion and invalidates on PX4 reset
writers: tryAlignPx4LocalFrameLocked; onPx4LocalPosition reset detection; activate/deactivate
readers: updateSetpoint coordinate conversion and safety checks
reset: clear when PX4 XY/Z reset counter changes or mode lifecycle resets
clock_unit: PX4 reset counters and source/steady stamps
identity: PX4 frame reset counters + localization epoch
protection: trajectory_mutex_

name: handover_requested_ / mission_terminal_ / failure_reported_
initialization: false on activation
meaning: NavigationMode terminal/failure handover gate; command arrival cannot reopen mission after terminal handover
writers: mission Complete/RequestPositionControl, failNavigation, deactivate/activate
readers: command admission, setpoint, mission timer
reset: on activate; set terminal/failure independently by events
identity: mission and current request
protection: trajectory_mutex_ for compound snapshots

name: px4_hold_confirmed_ / hold_handover_pending_ / hold_handover_in_flight_
initialization: false/0 on executor activate
meaning: API scheduling, API completion, and observed VehicleStatus AUTO_LOITER are distinct; vehicle status is confirmation
writers: request callback, schedulePx4Hold/API result, VehicleStatus callback, lifecycle reset
readers: 50 ms timer retry predicate
reset: confirmed AUTO_LOITER clears pending/in-flight; activation/deactivation clears all
clock_unit: steady ns retry timestamp, 250 ms after API failure
identity: held vehicle mode, no mission bundle id
protection: executor callbacks/timer; serialization from PX4 executor not inferred beyond source

name: CandidateBundle.valid_from_ns / valid_until_ns + NavigationCommand.valid_until
initialization: assigned on candidate export/commit and each command emission; message stream lease is now+100 ms by default
meaning: candidate validity and emitted stream validity are distinct windows; receipt time and source state freshness are independently checked
writers: planner candidate export; publishCommand message builder
readers: commit/activation/publishIfCurrent; NavigationMode commandContractValidAt/updateSetpoint
reset: expires by clock; no lease extension from stale sample; bounded recovery exceptions are identity-specific
clock_unit: ROS ns; source and steady receive clocks also used
identity: bundle generation and command sample id
protection: immutable bundle + store lock; mode cache mutex

name: ExecutionEpisodeSnapshot::phase / command_available / active_generation / safety_suffix_active / restart_from_rest
initialization: reset to InitialHold, unavailable, no active generation; beginGoal may retain an existing command
meaning: lifecycle, active authority and restart latch co-owned with recovery_state; more authoritative than free-standing mirror flags
writers: reset/beginGoal; commandCommitted; observeSampledSafetyRole; stoppedHold/requestRestartFromRest; failClosed
readers: planning admission, sample policy, candidate commit, final exposure and diagnostics
reset: exact generation/goal identity mutations; reset/failClosed clear ownership
identity: localization_epoch, goal_epoch, request_id, active_generation
protection: ExecutionEpisode mutex; compound runtime transitions also lock localization/input/lease transition

name: PlanningKey identity tuple
type: separate uint64 counters, enum start mode, int64 anchor stamp
initialization: invalid zero counters; formed per schedulePlanningCycle snapshot
meaning: localization epoch, goal epoch, request id, route revision, committed bundle generation, world generation/revision, start mode, anchor stamp and dynamics hash are distinct; none can substitute for another
writers: currentPlanningKey snapshots runtime state
readers: worker dedup/cancel, PlanningRequest validity, candidate output and commit recheck
reset: new state/request/world/anchor forms a new key; old result rejected by current key checks
clock_unit: anchor_stamp_ns in ROS time; no epoch unit conflation
identity: all listed tuple components are independent fields
protection: captured immutable value; inputs copied under runtime locks

name: WorldSnapshotIdentity::localization_epoch/generation/revision/observation_stamp_ns
initialization: set by mapping snapshot publication
meaning: world version and freshness witness separate from goal/request/bundle identity
writers: mapping worker/store publication
readers: planning request, recertification, candidate admission, activation, publish freshness gate
reset: new observation/revision/generation replaces snapshot; epoch change invalidates prior lineage
identity: localization epoch, world generation and revision, source observation stamp
protection: immutable snapshot identity; WorldSnapshotStore synchronization

name: ExecutionStateStore::state_ / ExecutionStateLease::ingress_sequence
initialization: empty; first accepted finite KinematicState establishes active epoch
meaning: latest immutable propagated state; monotonic source time and exact epoch gate publication; separate receive steady stamp and ingress sequence do not replace source-time freshness
writers: onPropagatedOdometry -> ExecutionStateStore::publish; resetForLocalizationEpoch
readers: PlanningKey, candidate anchor, emergency check, publishCommand final lease gate
reset: epoch reset clears exact cached lease
clock_unit: KinematicState source_stamp_ns in ROS clock; receive stamp steady clock
identity: localization epoch + ingress sequence; sequence is not freshness
protection: ExecutionStateStore mutex and immutable shared snapshot

name: trajectory_completion_witness_ / trajectory_reaches_goal_ / terminal_bundle_generation_
type: optional witness + atomic bool + uint64 generation
initialization: no witness / false / zero
meaning: terminal sampling and goal endpoint lineage; endpoint sample alone does not mean mission accepted or complete
scope: one candidate generation and goal request
writers: publishCommand only after matching completed sample; lifecycle/recovery/epoch reset clears
readers: currentPlanningKey terminal suppression, stopped hold predicate, terminal monitor admission
reset: identity mismatch, goal/epoch change, new request/recovery clears
clock_unit: witness source stamp and bundle valid window in ROS ns
identity: active goal and exact terminal bundle generation
protection: witness under transition locks; atomics use acquire/release

name: new_goal_
initialization: false
meaning: request transition marker used by planner/terminal guard while desired and executing goals may differ
writers: applyValidatedGoalLocked and commit/activation cleanup
readers: currentPlanningKey, commit, terminal monitor and retained callback predicates
reset: cleared after admitted successor cutover or rejected/invalidated request path
identity: active goal and execution goal tuple
protection: input_mutex_

name: hot_goal_transition_
initialization: false
meaning: retarget planner through committed-future successor path while prior command remains active
writers: applyValidatedGoalLocked; activation/fail/reset paths
readers: currentPlanningKey start mode, candidate stage/commit, terminal monitor
reset: cleared at matching successor activation or fail-closed reset
identity: desired request distinct from executing predecessor
protection: input_mutex_ and command transition lock

name: skip_replan_once_
initialization: false
meaning: one scheduler renewal suppressed after a stopped-state successful plan; a mirror, not recovery owner
writers: successful stopped-state plan; consume/reset in scheduler
readers: schedulePlanningCycle only

identity: current goal identity indirectly via runtime guard
protection: atomic; runtime transition sets related state

name: foreign_mission_hold_after_stop_ / foreign_mission_cancel_pending_
type: bool + atomic bool + target epoch tuple
initialization: false/false/zero
meaning: foreign mission change is treated as authority violation; moving certified suffix drains before fail-closed hold/cancel
writers: transitionForeignMissionLocked; measured stop consume path
readers: goal admission, stopped-recovery branch, worker cancellation guard
reset: clear after target epoch cancellation consumed or lifecycle reset
identity: foreign target, transition and localization epoch
protection: localization/input/command lock order plus atomics
